sources.snippet: Backbone: TinyViT-21M (tiny_vit_21m_224, 20.94 M parameters), initialised from ImageNet-22K distilled weights and fine-tuned end-to-end on the full VGGFace2 (3,057,398 face images / 8,414 identities). This is not a transformers model.
